in_english.name: Sufyanah
in_english.meaning: Feminine given name that refers to the companions of the Prophet Muhammad
in_english.long_meaning: The name Sufyanah is derived from the Arabic word 'sufyan,' which means companion or friend. In Islamic tradition, the companions of the Prophet Muhammad are highly revered and considered to be the best of generations. The name Sufyanah is given to girls who are considered to be virtuous, wise, and strong-willed, much like the companions of the Prophet Muhammad. The name is also associated with the qualities of compassion, kindness, and generosity, which are highly valued in Islamic culture. In modern times, the name Sufyanah is given to girls who are considered to be intelligent, courageous, and determined, and who embody the values of the companions of the Prophet Muhammad.
